jobs.title: Mechanical Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At AION, we're building sci-fi medical devices.

The role

As a Mechanical Engineer at AION, you will:

  • Design and build custom hardware for biological experiments
  • Own the work end to end: requirements, prototypes, validation

Details

St. Louis, MO (on-site).

Equity for the right person.
